description: PR-09 first segment: remote DSH host over SSH (ADR-0006) — SSH wire encodings, host profile validation and storage, host-key pin, trust rule, remote dsh web launch-token parsing. Generated by tooling/gen-remote-ssh-vectors.py from an independent model of the legacy Kotlin rules (RemoteHosts.kt / SshKeys.kt). Run by the legacy Kotlin (native-bridge LegacyRemoteSshParityTest) and the C# port (RemoteSshParityTests). csharpOnly = Android libcore org.json semantics (the JVM tests use the real org.json). trust is C# only: the legacy rule is inline in RemoteHosts.trust (source contract). PR-09 second segment (ADR-0012): hostKeyAlgorithms (legacy: JSch.getConfig("server_host_key"); C#: the restricted SSH.NET ConnectionInfo), connectOutcome / jschKind (the legacy connect catch block) and probe (legacy runProbe / exec): the legacy Kotlin test runs the same expressions as RemoteHosts.kt, which a C# source contract pins. PR-09 third segment (ADR-0013): launchOutput (readTokenLine), afterStart and stillRunning (startDsh / stopDsh verdicts), same arrangement.
